user_input.text: Is CAD assembly me jo part collide kr rha h detect kro aur minimum change se fix kro

preconditions: assembly constraints and intended motion understood
plan: identify colliding bodies and motion state

recovery.strategy: undo geometry change if it introduces new interference or breaks constraints

final_output.text: Interference evidence se exact collision isolate karke minimum geometry change aur post-fix motion check karunga.

user_input.text: PC pr jo file open h uska latest backup cloud aur phone dono me rkh do

preconditions: active file path resolved
ensure latest unsaved changes are saved or captured

criteria: cloud and phone copies match same latest revision

recovery.strategy: retry failed destination independently without duplicating verified copies

final_output.text: Current latest revision ko hash karke cloud aur phone dono par identical backup verify karunga.

user_input.text: Mere repo me jo failing test h usko fix kro but test delete ya weaken mt krna

preconditions: reproduce failing test and inspect intent
plan: patch implementation rather than weakening assertion

recovery.strategy: revert patch if it only masks failure

final_output.text: Failing assertion ko evidence maan kar implementation fix karunga; test remove/loosen nahi karunga.

user_input.text: Phone me jo unknown app battery kha rhi h identify kro aur safe ho to uninstall kr do

safety.reason: uninstalling an app is destructive and may remove data

preconditions: identify package, battery usage, system/admin/device-policy role and user importance

recovery.strategy: do not uninstall unknown/system package from battery percentage alone

final_output.text: Battery-heavy app ki identity/criticality pehle verify karunga; uninstall se pehle exact package confirm karunga.

user_input.text: Is enclosure ko ventilation improve krni h but dust entry kam rehni chahiye redesign kro

preconditions: know heat sources, airflow direction, fan presence, dust environment and protected openings
plan: estimate free area and filter/labyrinth tradeoff

criteria: ventilation change is justified against stated constraints

recovery.strategy: iterate from temperature/dust test data

final_output.text: Vent size blindly badhana dust goal ko hurt kar sakta hai; heat source/fan/environment constraints chahiye.

user_input.text: Latest client mail se requirements nikalo aur project TODO update kr do

preconditions: retrieve latest matching client message and preserve quoted requirement provenance

criteria: TODO changes trace to actual mail content

recovery.strategy: flag ambiguous requests as questions instead of converting them to definitive tasks

final_output.text: Latest client mail se explicit requirements/deadlines nikal kar source-linked TODO update karunga.

user_input.text: Agar PC ka internet chala jaye to current coding work save krke phone hotspot se reconnect kr dena

preconditions: hotspot credentials/procedure authorized
avoid disrupting already-good alternate network

criteria: PC reconnects through intended hotspot when condition occurs

recovery.strategy: restore previous network preference if hotspot path fails

final_output.text: Connectivity-loss par pehle work save hoga, phir hotspot fallback aur network verification with cooldown.

user_input.text: Is STL ke 4 variants bnao 20 25 30 35 mm width me baki proportions same rkhna

preconditions: determine whether uniform scaling actually preserves intended proportions/interfaces
plan: identify width axis and protected interfaces
choose parametric or controlled scaling strategy

recovery.strategy: do not uniform-scale if it would alter protected holes/wall thickness without approval

final_output.text: Width variants generate karunga, lekin protected interfaces ko accidental scale hone se bachakar dimensions verify karunga.

user_input.text: Windows update pending h kar do but mera server aur unsaved kaam safe rehna chahiye

safety.reason: OS update/restart is consequential and disruptive

preconditions: save user work
inspect active server/jobs
know whether restart required
plan: verify server and critical apps restored

criteria: critical server returns healthy after update

recovery.strategy: use documented recovery/rollback path if update breaks critical service

final_output.text: Pehle work/server state safe aur recoverable karunga; restart/update execute karne se pehle confirmation lunga.

user_input.text: Is screenshot me jo table h data CSV me nikal do aur totals cross check kro

preconditions: table text/numbers sufficiently legible

criteria: computed totals reconcile or discrepancy explicitly reported

recovery.strategy: mark unreadable cells unknown instead of guessing digits

final_output.text: Table ko structured CSV me extract karke totals independently calculate aur mismatch flag karunga.

user_input.text: BLE device connect ho gya bol rha h but data update nhi ho rha actual issue trace kro

plan: separate link-connected state from service discovery

criteria: diagnosis identifies evidence-backed first failure between connection and UI state

recovery.strategy: fix one boundary and retest full data path

final_output.text: Connected flag ko success nahi maanunga; discovery→subscription→packet→parser→UI chain trace karunga.

user_input.text: Mere video folder se best 3 clips choose kro jisme machine clearly working dikhe aur ek reel sequence bna do

preconditions: define observable criterion: machine action clearly visible

criteria: each selected segment visibly demonstrates machine operation

recovery.strategy: ask for aesthetic preference only if multiple sequences tie materially

final_output.text: Machine operation visibility ko primary criterion bana kar 3 non-duplicate clips aur draft reel sequence prepare karunga.

user_input.text: GitHub issue me jo bug report h usko reproduce kro fix kro aur PR ready kr do

safety.reason: opening a PR is an external repository action

preconditions: read exact issue acceptance context
protect dirty worktree

criteria: bug reproduction fails before patch and passes after

recovery.strategy: do not open PR when tests fail or scope is unresolved

final_output.text: Bug reproduce→patch→test complete karke PR preview banaunga; actual PR open se pehle confirm karunga.

user_input.text: Machine ka noise normal se alg lag rha h sensors aur current data check krke btao stop krni h ya nhi

safety.policy: emergency stop may execute only on explicit safety threshold/event policy

preconditions: compare current data against known normal envelope/procedure
plan: if explicit safety threshold exceeded execute authorized safe-stop policy else report evidence/uncertainty

criteria: stop recommendation/action follows measured threshold/procedure rather than sound impression alone

recovery.strategy: escalate to manual inspection when data cannot discriminate mechanical fault

final_output.text: Noise ko signal maanunga, proof nahi; sensor/current/baseline se risk classify karke stop decision lunga.

user_input.text: Phone me ek photo h uska exact project dhundo laptop pr aur relevant files kholo

preconditions: extract non-sensitive project cues from photo/metadata
plan: open only high-confidence project and relevant artifacts

criteria: opened files correspond to evidence from photo/metadata

recovery.strategy: present top candidates if evidence cannot uniquely identify project

final_output.text: Photo ke visual/metadata cues se project resolve karke sirf evidence-backed relevant laptop files open karunga.

user_input.text: App crash ke baad automatically reopen ho aur same task continue ho but duplicate action na ho

preconditions: task identity/checkpoint semantics defined
plan: persist task state and idempotency key

criteria: verified side-effecting actions are not duplicated

recovery.strategy: mark uncertain external side effect for reconciliation rather than blindly retry

final_output.text: Restart alone enough nahi; persisted checkpoint + idempotency + side-effect reconciliation implement karunga.

user_input.text: Client ke diye 3 options me best manufacturing method choose kro cost aur quality dono dekhke

preconditions: know production quantity, material, tolerances, finish and budget/priority weights
plan: compare cost at quantity and quality/tolerance

recovery.strategy: revise recommendation if quantities/constraints change

final_output.text: Best method quantity/tolerance/finish par depend karega; in decision-critical values ke bina cost-vs-quality ranking guess hogi.

user_input.text: Mere laptop aur phone dono me same folder sync rkhna but delete ek side se ho to dusri side se auto delete mt krna

preconditions: define canonical identity/hash and conflict naming
plan: copy missing/newer nonconflicting files both ways

recovery.strategy: stop sync on unresolved same-name divergent content if conflict policy cannot safely preserve both

final_output.text: Two-way sync karunga with non-propagating deletes; conflicts ko overwrite nahi, preserve karunga.

user_input.text: Jo task worker success bol rha h usko independently verify kro planner ke status pr trust mt kro

preconditions: load task-specific observable completion criteria
plan: mark complete only if criteria pass

criteria: independent observation satisfies task-specific completion criteria

recovery.strategy: recover from first unverified boundary rather than rerunning whole task blindly

final_output.text: Worker ACK ko evidence nahi maanunga; target state independently observe karke hi complete mark karunga.

user_input.text: Mai exact workflow nhi bataunga, bas final result aur constraints de raha hu. KEREN khud plan bna ke execute kre

safety.policy: autonomy over method never overrides authority boundaries for consequential actions

preconditions: convert user goal and constraints into explicit acceptance criteria

criteria: all explicit acceptance criteria satisfied by observed final state

recovery.strategy: change plan/tool/node while preserving completed subgoals and idempotency

final_output.text: User ko micro-steps dene ki zarurat nahi; goal/constraints se acceptance criteria bana kar KEREN workflow discover, execute, replan aur verify karega.
